title: Prepared reader performance

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved continuation focused on perceptible responsiveness and static/prepared rendering

verificationRecords.scope: Eight cohorts compared with prepared-baseline; static candidate rejected for payload growth and unchanged layout counts. Semantic/compiler tests, app types, architecture, build and primary smoke passed before removal.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:computed-style-clone; npm run visual:cancellation; npm run check:architecture
verificationRecords.scope: Color focus projection across three engines, focused division lifecycle canary, and architecture; diagnostic builds 53 to 25.
Twelve bidirectional cycles preserve visible glyph geometry and identity with four builds; resize, font invalidation and pagehide retire all owned layers. Smoke 41 and architecture/types passed.

allowedWork: Precompiled reader instructions, preparation and paint lifecycle repairs, bounded reuse and prewarming, measured resource checks, existing regression reconciliation
disallowedWork: New visual treatment, universal renderer, worker rewrite, fixed SVG replacement, derivation-trail product UI, deployment or destructive Git operations
goal: Reduce visible preparation stalls with precompiled instructions and bounded valid reuse

slices.title: Static-publication
slices.summary: Baseline and static-publication experiment complete. Asset-only precompilation increased payload without meaningful traversal benefit and was removed; evidence identifies nominal publication constraints and prioritizes geometry reuse.

slices.title: Paint-and-geometry
slices.summary: Declared color-only focus refreshes inert material paint without invalidating geometry; interpolation remains native and bounded host scheduling cancels on retirement.

slices.title: Prepared-replay
slices.summary: Bounded exact-key transition reuse eliminates warm preparation builds; native endpoint parking and global measurement invalidation preserve paint ownership.
